Title: Raspberry Pi 1GB Compute Module 4 with WiFi, 32GB eMMC - CM4101032
Product_Overview: CM4101032 is a Raspberry Pi Compute Module 4 (CM4) which is System on Module (SoM) containing processor, memory, eMMC Flash and supporting power circuitry. This module allows a designer to leverage Raspberry Pi HW and SW stack in their own custom systems and form factors. In addition, module has extra IO interfaces over and above what is available on Raspberry Pi boards, opening up more options for designer. The design of CM4 is loosely based on Raspberry Pi 4 Model B, and for cost-sensitive applications.
